faq.q: How do I get the files?
faq.a: Right after payment we email you a private download link. It works for 7 days and for up to 5 downloads. Nothing is posted and no account is needed.

faq.q: What do I need to use it?
faq.a: A website where you can add a script tag. A destination for leads: a Google account (for the Apps Script route), or any webhook URL, or a Node.js 18+ server for the relay. Optional: your own Anthropic or OpenAI API key, only for AI answers (billed to you by the provider).

faq.q: Who is it for?
faq.a: Small business owners, tradies, agencies and freelancers with an HTML, WordPress or other website who want a simple lead capture chat without a monthly subscription, and who are comfortable pasting code into a page or hiring someone to do it.

digital.description: A small chat bubble for your website, written in plain HTML and JavaScript with no dependencies. It asks a visitor five questions (name, email, phone, what they need, and when they want to start), checks the answers, and sends the lead to you. The quickest route is a free Google Apps Script that emails you and logs each lead in a Google Sheet, and the pack includes the script ready to paste. You can also point it at any webhook, such as n8n, Make or Zapier, or run the included Node relay on your own server. You can change the questions, colours and wording. Optional FAQ answers need no AI. Optional AI answers run through your own server using your own API key, and no key is ever placed in the browser. The pack includes a PDF setup guide, general privacy notes for Australian businesses, a demo page, and the tests we ran. You host everything yourself and there is no monthly fee from us.
